sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Guidelines for performing Mendelian randomization investigations: update for summer 2023》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】It is aimed at practitioners seeking to undertake analyses and write up their findings, and at journal editors and reviewers seeking to assess Mendelian randomization manuscripts.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Guidelines for performing Mendelian randomization investigations: update for summer 2023》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】The guidelines are divided into ten sections: motivation and scope, data sources, choice of genetic variants, variant harmonization, primary analysis, supplementary and sensitivity analyses (one section on robust statistical methods and one on other approaches), extensions and additional analyses, data presentation, and interpretation.
